dnssec_enabled.title: DNSSEC Signing Enabled
dnssec_enabled.description: Whether DNSSEC signing is enabled for the zone, meaning DNS records are cryptographically signed with RRSIG records and a DNSKEY is published.

dnssec_enabled_at_zone.title: DNSSEC Enabled at Authoritative Zone
dnssec_enabled_at_zone.description: Indicates whether DNSSEC signing is active on the authoritative zone, confirmed by presence of both DNSKEY and RRSIG records at the zone apex.

ds_record_published.title: DS Record Published at Parent Zone
ds_record_published.description: Whether a Delegation Signer (DS) record has been published at the parent zone (e.g., TLD registry), establishing the chain of trust from parent to child zone.

ds_record_published_at_parent.title: DS Record Published at Parent Zone (Chain of Trust)
ds_record_published_at_parent.description: Indicates whether a Delegation Signer (DS) record for the zone is published in the parent (TLD) zone, linking the chain of trust from parent to child.

root_to_tld_trust_anchor_validated.title: Root-to-TLD Trust Anchor Validated
root_to_tld_trust_anchor_validated.description: Indicates whether the TLD zone has a valid DS record published at the root zone, confirming the chain of trust extends from the ICANN root trust anchor through the TLD.

dnssec_validation_enabled.title: DNSSEC Validation Enabled
dnssec_validation_enabled.description: Whether the DNS resolver is configured to perform DNSSEC signature validation on responses (e.g., dnssec-validation yes/auto in BIND, equivalent in Unbound/PowerDNS).

trust_anchor_configured.title: Trust Anchor Configured
trust_anchor_configured.description: Whether a valid DNSSEC trust anchor (root KSK or zone-specific anchor) is configured on the resolver, providing the cryptographic root of trust for signature chain validation.

dnssec_validation_mode.title: DNSSEC Validation Mode
dnssec_validation_mode.description: The strictness level of DNSSEC validation: 'enforce' (or 'enforced') rejects unsigned/invalid responses with SERVFAIL, 'permissive' (or 'advisory') logs failures but allows them, 'disabled' performs no validation.

validation_failure_action.title: Validation Failure Action
validation_failure_action.description: The action taken by the resolver when DNSSEC signature validation fails or signatures are missing for signed zones.

cd_flag_enforcement_mode.title: Checking Disabled Flag Enforcement Mode
cd_flag_enforcement_mode.description: How the resolver handles DNS queries with the CD (Checking Disabled) flag set. 'hard_fail' enforces validation regardless of CD flag; 'permissive' allows CD flag to bypass validation; 'off' means no enforcement.

unsigned_zone_acceptance.title: Unsigned Zone Acceptance Policy
unsigned_zone_acceptance.description: Whether the resolver accepts responses from unsigned (non-DNSSEC) zones. 'reject_bogus_only' means unsigned zones pass but forged signatures fail; 'accept_all_unsigned' means no distinction is enforced; 'reject_unsigned' means all zones must be signed.

negative_response_proof_type.title: Negative Response Proof Type
negative_response_proof_type.description: The mechanism used to authenticate negative responses (NXDOMAIN/NODATA): NSEC provides authenticated denial of existence, NSEC3 provides hashed denial to prevent zone enumeration, none if not configured.

rrsig_coverage_percentage.title: RRSIG Signature Coverage Percentage
rrsig_coverage_percentage.description: Percentage of DNS resource record sets (RRsets) in the zone that have valid, non-expired RRSIG signatures covering them.

signature_expiry_monitoring_enabled.title: Signature Expiry Monitoring Enabled
signature_expiry_monitoring_enabled.description: Whether automated monitoring or alerting is configured to detect RRSIG records approaching or past their expiration timestamp before they lapse.

alert_threshold_days_before_expiry.title: Alert Threshold Days Before Expiry
alert_threshold_days_before_expiry.description: Number of days before RRSIG expiration at which monitoring alerts are triggered. A value of zero means no advance warning is configured.

key_rollover_procedure_configured.title: Key Rollover Procedure Configured
key_rollover_procedure_configured.description: Indicates whether scheduled KSK and ZSK rotation procedures are formally documented and configured in the DNSSEC management system.

pre_publish_overlap_enabled.title: Pre-Publish Key Overlap Enabled
pre_publish_overlap_enabled.description: Indicates whether the rollover process publishes new keys before retiring old ones, ensuring continuous validation coverage during the transition period.

rollover_automation_status.title: Key Rollover Automation Status
rollover_automation_status.description: Describes whether key rollover is automated, manually scheduled, or not configured at all.

dnssec_validation_chain_status.title: DNSSEC Validation Chain Status
dnssec_validation_chain_status.description: The overall validation result when a DNSSEC-validating resolver attempts to resolve the domain, reflecting the end-to-end chain integrity.
